parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Describes the type of functionality that {{object}} is representing. {{deprecated|2.21|because it is replaced by {{param|MultiLevelSensorType}}}}

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Human-readable description of the {{object}}. e.g. a more detailed description of {{param|MultiLevelSensorType}}.

parameters.name: Values
parameters.description: The current value reading of this {{object}} in units defined in {{param|Unit}}. {{deprecated|2.21|because it is replaced by {{param|Sensor.{i}.Value}}}}

parameters.name: ValueNames
parameters.description: The names of the values expressed in {{param|Values}}. {{deprecated|2.21|because it is replaced by {{param|Sensor.{i}.ValueName}}}}

parameters.name: LastChange
parameters.description: The date and time when one of the {{param|Sensor.{i}.Value}} has been changed.

parameters.name: LastContactTime
parameters.description: The date and time in UTC when the {{object}} has received data.

parameters.name: Unit
parameters.description: {{datatype|expand}} Unit in which {{param|Values}} are expressed. {{deprecated|2.21|because it is replaced by {{param|Sensor.{i}.Unit}}}}

object.description: MultiLevelSensor is used to reflect the functionality of a sensor that reports multiple sensor values. Each sensor value can have the same or different sensor units.
